page.layout: One printed page. Full-width dedication heading at the top, centred, in roman and italic capitals. Below it, the greeting "MELCHIOR IUNIUS S. P. D." Then one text column with a woodcut initial S. Signature ")( 2" at the foot right. No running head, no page number, no marginal notes.

main_text.head: Illustrissimis Princi-pibus ac Dominis: Domino JULIO ERNESTO & Domino FRANCISCO Ducib. Brun-suicensibus & Luneburgensibus, Dominis suis clementissimis
main_text.p: Scholis ego aliquot Rhetoricis, Illustriss. Princi-pes, Domini clementissimi, contexendarum Epistolarum rationem, paucos ante annos, auditoribus meis, e-

page.notes: The woodcut initial S is joined to "cholis" as "Scholis". The line "Rhe-/toricis" has no printed hyphen at the line end, so it is written whole. The printed "=" hyphens are written as "-". The line-end hyphen "e-" is printed and is kept. The printed "acDominis" spacing is normalised to "ac Dominis". The page is cut off at "e-" and the sentence continues on the next page. The tops of the ornaments are not text and are not transcribed.
